title: Work shifts
name: Name
invalidRange: End date must not be before start date

shift.title: Shift
shift.segmentsHint: Overnight: an end time earlier than the start (e.g. 22:00 – 06:00) ends the next day; the shift belongs to its start date
shift.confirmDelete: Delete this shift? Shifts used by a schedule or an upcoming special day cannot be deleted.

schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.anchorDateHint: The date of "Day 1"; earlier and later dates repeat the cycle
schedule.ignoreHolidaysHint: For 24/7 teams (security, on-call): days off declared at a broader level than the assignment (e.g. company holidays) are ignored. Personal days off still apply.
schedule.confirmDelete: Delete this schedule? Schedules in use cannot be deleted.
schedule.firstWeekHint: Pick any date: the week containing it (Monday → Sunday) is Week 1; later and earlier weeks repeat the cycle. When the schedule takes effect is set in Assignments

assignment.autoCloseHint: The current schedule ends the day before the start date. If you set an end date, the previous schedule resumes after it.
assignment.toHint: Leave empty for no end date
assignment.noneApplied: No schedule applies (not even at company level). Employees here will show "No schedule".
assignment.userHint: A personal schedule overrides the department schedule. Use it only for people working differently (e.g. part-time, night duty).

override.name: Name
override.namePlaceholder: e.g. Lunar New Year, Make-up Saturday
override.copyConfirm: Copy company special days from {{from}} to {{to}}?
override.copyHint: Keeps day / month and skips dates that already exist. Lunar-calendar holidays must be adjusted after copying.
